Now, to find out how many more unique winners Survivor has compared to American Idol, I subtract the number of Idol winners from Survivor winners: 44 - 15 = 29. So, Survivor has 29 more unique winners than American Idol.

Also, for American Idol, each season did have one winner, so 15 is correct. Therefore, the difference is indeed 29.
</think>
